propositions: Current clarity_score logic duplicated across two modules awards points for volume and shape (H2 headings, length thresholds, bullet points) without verifying required section content or author-guide conformance, enabling padded tickets with missing Approach or grounded Scope to pass.

Clarity measure must be rebuilt around required-section shape keyed on plan altitude (leaf vs. container), per-AC verification coverage with explicit proof clauses, and placeholder-free executable scope rather than generic length and heading counts.

Author-facing guidance contradicts test expectations on Success Criteria inclusion and rejected-alternative requirements, creating ambiguity that deterministic checks cannot resolve until upstream bug 828a-7407-9d68-4b82 is fixed.

Detection rules for deterministic additions (structured file_impact, placeholder lexicon scanning, AC checkbox proof clauses, Testing shape markers) are specified but not yet validated against corpus; incomplete AC coverage should remain advisory pending precision evaluation.
